image_description: A still life composition on a black background featuring a large, curved green cucumber as the central subject. The cucumber has two distinct clusters of white, root-like tendrils or sprouts emerging from its side. Flanking the cucumber are two round tomatoes with red and yellow coloration. Below the main group lies a single, slender green bean or pea pod.

artifact_observations.location: Central body of the cucumber, mid-section
artifact_observations.reasoning: Two large, complex white root/tendril clusters are growing directly out of the lateral skin of the cucumber. This is biologically implausible for a harvested fruit and represents a severe structural hallucination/fusion error.

A distinct, sharp-edged pale white stripe runs along the bottom curve. While striping exists in some varieties, this appears as a texture mapping error or bleaching artifact rather than natural pigmentation.
Slight ambiguity in contact shadows and edge definition where the cucumber overlaps the tomatoes, suggesting minor depth compositing issues.
